brief.scope: Work order: the uncited-correction gate. The requirements are the ten numbered Contract items of .dev/ladder-inputs/scope-gate-20260910.md, tracked in this snapshot at the ref; read it and .dev/ladder-inputs/scope-discipline.md WHOLE from the snapshot tree. Nothing else is a requirement. Refuse at mint any write job that answers reviewer findings unless every finding it answers is named by key, disposed in the findings ledger, and the disposition cites the numbered contract item it violates; the ladder stops before its fix stages instead of correcting. No override. Boundaries as listed there; do not widen them.

findings.claim: Contract item 1 is bypassed for symlinked review artifacts. Classification resolves the input before checking whether its argument is beneath a review job's out/, so an out/ symlink targeting elsewhere returns no review record. The launcher later follows that same symlink with shutil.copyfile. A lane harness writing its permitted out/ can therefore make an input-only correction mint with answers [] and cause the conductor to copy a readable file from outside the job.
findings.reproduce:
python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib.util, json, shutil, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('ops/conductor/tools/correction.py').resolve()
s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('audit_correction', p)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s)
s.loader.exec_module(m)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    t = Path(td); records = t/'records'; jobs = t/'jobs'; records.mkdir()
    rid = '20260901T000000Z-review-grok-aaaaaa'
    (records/f'{rid}.json').write_text(json.dumps({'id': rid, 'job': 'adversarial-review'}))
    outside = t/'outside-secret'; outside.write_text('outside-job-data')
    link = jobs/rid/'out'/'review.md'; link.parent.mkdir(parents=True); link.symlink_to(outside)
    copied = t/'copied'; shutil.copyfile(link, copied)
    print(link.is_relative_to(jobs/rid/'out'), copied.read_text())
    print(m.check('write', [], [str(link)], [], '2026-09-11T00:00:00Z', records, jobs, Path.cwd()))
PY
